description: Índice de incidencia de la sequía en Andalucía. Estudio comarcal is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by descargasrediam.cica.es. The drought monitoring and evaluation system, operational since September 2016, uses a methodology that takes into account the amount of rainfall recorded by meteorological stations and its impact on the natural environment and on agricultural crops, which are captured by sensors installed on satellites. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Incidence rate of drought in Andalusia. Regional study" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Índice, Zonas de riesgos naturales, Sequía, Vegetación, Opendata, Teledetección. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
